requirements_summary: Mid-market PLG company building in-app guided onboarding copilot. POC scope: validate Hosted API can meet interactive latency SLOs for streaming chat (95p < 400ms), reliable function/tool calling to product-metrics service (error rate <1%), and token cost controls (cap per session + soft-budget alerts).
